basis: completed regular-season games where the market price was recorded within 6 hours of tip-off, against the number we published before the game
excluded_note: 161 of 230 completed games are graded. The 69 left out: 46 from the season's opening stretch, before our model had seen enough games to make a call we could grade; 16 from the most recent nights, where the closing prices landed after the current model was built; and 7 with no price on record we could fairly call a closing price. Those games were decided by 10.7 points on average against 11.4 for the graded ones.
